articles.title: Watch: Why has Trump been so eager to welcome Xi?
articles.description: President Donald Trump has been talking about Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit for months, the BBC's Sarah Smith looks at why.

articles.title: Anti-migrant activist charged after dinghy slashed in Channel

articles.title: White House restores access to media outlets banned by Trump after judge's order

articles.title: Netanyahu defends Israeli military action as delegates walk out before UN speech
articles.description: The Israeli leader labels those who left his speech at the UN General Assembly as "moral cowards".
